READ-ONLY IMPACT INVENTORY FOR THE PRODUCER FORK — exact 6a218927 export, no source edit.

Repository-wide Scala search finds exactly two LocalCostModel implementations: DefaultLocalCostModel and the laws-only SpyCostModel wrapper. FunctionPrior has no production construction outside its own default/none values. DefaultLocalCostModel is constructed by fixtures/tests/laws and one embed-bench report path, while ordinary consumers call GraphHsmm.infer, which already returns Either[AlignError, HsmmResult].

That makes one coherent remedy mechanically bounded: make the local producer path fallible, validate all CostBreakdown fields at its sole construction boundary, validate the raw external cost before CostBreakdown.external, and propagate the first AlignError through GraphHsmm.run/infer. Stable blend arithmetic is still required for the finite-aggregate/extreme-imbalance case; failure propagation handles mathematically unrepresentable totals and hostile custom models without clamps or exceptions. The laws spy is the only in-repo custom implementation to update. This may fit the existing cost/hsmm/laws/test envelope without a new module or dependency, but it is a public trait signature change and therefore remains chief-owned authority.

The alternative remains a hard landing dependency on a separately scoped producer-integrity P0. This inventory does not authorize either choice; it shows the fallible route is contained rather than repo-wide guesswork.
